rq: joint identification of raw-language equivalence and latent intervention-target partition
primary_work: Kekic, Scholkopf, and Besserve, Targeted Reduction of Causal Models
reason: TCR identifies compact causal factors relevant to a supplied target phenomenon under shift-intervention assumptions, but presupposes the target and intervention interface. Perfect target reduction remains invariant under joint recoding of utterance classes, target blocks, intervention arguments, target/evaluator bookkeeping, and denotation; target-response-equivalent factors can also admit distinct semantic merge/split ontologies.
surviving_rq: After recovering the finest target-relevance quotient from legitimate interventions and the finest raw-language quotient from language dynamics, can independently fixed preregistered cross-system probes eliminate the residual joint automorphism and identify Q, residual P, and d without parser, target-label, reward, or evaluator leakage?
